workflow: One original opaque landscape per boss and one color world-tree scene. Source PNGs copied unchanged. Android renders the title in green and reveals the source colors at the ending. Battlefield luminance is bounded at draw time.

backgrounds.name: 色を待つ世界樹
backgrounds.motif: The same world tree before and after the return of color.
backgrounds.prompt: Create an original finished high-detail 16-bit pixel art fantasy RPG TITLE SCREEN BACKGROUND, landscape 16:9, full bleed opaque. Absolutely NO text, logos, letters, HUD, borders, characters or watermark. Exquisitely detailed pixel clusters, tiny chiseled highlights, rich classic JRPG environmental illustration. A vast majestic Yggdrasil world-tree towering on the RIGHT HALF at sunrise, intricate twisting bark, jewel-like leaves, a delicate broken Nordic stone arch and rune carvings (abstract decorative marks not readable text) at its roots, distant cliffside fortress and layered misty valleys. The world has just regained color: restrained emerald and teal foliage, gold sunrise, lavender-blue distant mountains, amber fireflies, pale peach clouds. Small stone path on lower right at 72% horizontal, 80% vertical for game to draw a hero. Composition VERY IMPORTANT: entire LEFT 48% is a dark, subdued low-contrast forest/cavern silhouette, nearly black blue-green with only faint fine foliage; it is empty negative space behind the game's large title and buttons. Concentrate light and all major objects on the RIGHT 50%. Monumental world-tree canopy, distant archways, finely crafted layered vegetation. Clear crisp pixel art without painterly blur, no modern elements, no built-in character. Beautiful luminous dawn, an emotionally uplifting ending scene that also works as a monochrome title background.

backgrounds.name: 根を巡る伝令の庭
backgrounds.motif: An ancient Yggdrasil root clearing: gigantic interwoven bark roots form the upper boundary, carved root tunnels, tiny acorn caches, fern fronds, messenger paths winding above the arena, soft drifting seed light. Twisting woodland roots and carved bark distinguish this from any other forest. Broad empty compact moss-earth ground.
backgrounds.prompt: Create a finished original fantasy RPG BATTLE BACKGROUND game asset, high-detail finely crafted 16-bit pixel art with the lavish ornamental detail of classic Romancing SaGa boss scenes, but ORIGINAL Norse mythology environment. Landscape 16:9 composition, full bleed opaque image, no transparency. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, UI, borders, watermarks, characters, enemies, weapons lying in the playable area, or modern elements. Strict monochromatic GAME BOY sage-green palette: near-black green #101d1a, deep forest green #23382d, medium moss #6f8a5b, small pale sage #b8cd95 highlights ONLY on architecture around outer edges. Crisp pixel clusters, intentional 1-3 pixel highlights, intricate carved stone, material texture and convincing depth; no blur, no smooth painted shading, no photographic rendering. View the floor from a steep top-down three-quarter tactical RPG camera. Playable arena is the ENTIRE central 78% width and 72% height and must be a clear continuous flat ground plane, including center foreground. Ground is subdued dark green and legible, sparse low-contrast texture, no big ornamental floor circles, grids, target marks, rays, glowing cracks, stripes or area-attack lookalikes. Put lavish decorative detail in narrow top 20% and outer side edges, keep foreground edge unobstructed. No thick frame. Distant scenery only in the upper strip; this is a usable overhead action-game floor, not a side-view landscape. Every border object remains outside central playable area. Scene: An ancient Yggdrasil root clearing: gigantic interwoven bark roots form the upper boundary, carved root tunnels, tiny acorn caches, fern fronds, messenger paths winding above the arena, soft drifting seed light. Twisting woodland roots and carved bark distinguish this from any other forest. Broad empty compact moss-earth ground.
